# Yohanes Pratama Naibaho

> Yohanes Pratama Naibaho, also known as Yohanes Naibaho, is a software engineer in Jakarta. His main focus is frontend architecture, with experience in full-stack systems, test automation, and cloud reliability.

He builds software for banking and manufacturing teams. His current work includes a shared microfrontend framework, component library, and multilingual system used by more than 20 teams.

## Experience

- Frontend Engineer working on QLola at Bank Rakyat Indonesia.
- Former Associate Software Engineer at LG Group, where he led enterprise platform work across more than 10 global sites.
- Maintained 99.99% availability, latency below 52 ms, and an error rate below 0.1% during a three-wave cloud migration.
- Previous roles include QA Automation Engineer at BPJS Kesehatan and Software Developer at Knight Connections.
